papers.title: On the measurement of dimensional quality of titanium alloy micro lattice struts manufactured using selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The paper describes the measurement of the surface quality, dimensional accuracy, and cross sectional circularity of titanium alloy ( Ti-6Al-4V ) micro struts manufactured using selective laser melting. This quality is related to manufacturing and materials characteristics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文测量了SLM制造的Ti-6Al-4V微格栅支柱的尺寸质量，但未涉及应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等生物力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper only measures dimensional quality of as-built struts, with no link to stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 表征SLM制造钛合金微格栅支柱的尺寸精度和表面质量。
summary_zh.method: 使用光学和电子显微镜测量支柱的直径、圆度及表面形貌。
summary_zh.result: 发现制造支柱存在尺寸偏差和表面粗糙度，与工艺参数相关。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多组样本测量对比工艺影响。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the dimensional accuracy and surface quality of Ti-6Al-4V micro lattice struts fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Optical and electron microscopy were used to measure strut diameter, circularity, and surface morphology.
summary_en.result: As-built struts exhibited dimensional deviations and surface roughness correlated with process parameters.
summary_en.validation: Multiple samples were measured to quantify the influence of manufacturing parameters on quality.

papers.title: The interaction of adipose-derived human mesenchymal stem cells and polyether ether ketone
papers.abstract: Polyether ether ketone (PEEK) as a high-performance, thermoplastic implant material entered the field of medical applications due to its structural function and commercial availability. In bone tissue engineering, the combination of mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) with PEEK implants may accelerate the bone formation and promote the osseointegration between the implant and the adjacent bone tissue. In this concept the question how PEEK influences the behaviour and functions of MSCs is of great interest. Here the cellular response of human adipose-derived MSCs to PEEK was evaluated and compared to tissue culture plate (TCP) as the reference material. Viability and morphology of cells were not altered when cultured on the PEEK film. The cells on PEEK presented a high proliferation activity in spite of a relatively lower initial cell adhesion rate. There was no significant difference on cell apoptosis and senescence between the cells on PEEK and TCP. The inflammatory cytokines and VEGF secreted by the cells on these two surfaces were at similar levels. The cells on PEEK showed up-regulated BMP2 and down-regulated BMP4 and BMP6 gene expression, whereas no conspicuous differences were observed in the committed osteoblast markers (BGLAP, COL1A1 and Runx2). With osteoinduction the cells on PEEK and TCP exhibited a similar osteogenic differentiation potential. Our results demonstrate the biofunctionality of PEEK for human MSC cultivation and differentiation. Its clinical benefits in bone tissue engineering may be achieved by combining MSCs with PEEK implants. These data may also provide useful information for further modification of PEEK with chemical or physical methods to regulate the cellular processes of MSCs and to consequently improve the efficacy of MSC-PEEK based therapies.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究PEEK材料与干细胞的相互作用，但未涉及LPBF制造、力学测试或应力屏蔽，与AM生物医学方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, and no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估PEEK对人间充质干细胞行为的影响，以促进骨整合。
summary_zh.method: 将人脂肪干细胞培养于PEEK膜上，检测细胞活性、增殖、凋亡及成骨分化。
summary_zh.result: PEEK支持干细胞增殖和成骨分化，但初始粘附率较低。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验，以组织培养板为对照。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the biocompatibility of PEEK with human mesenchymal stem cells for potential bone tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Human adipose-derived MSCs were cultured on PEEK films and assessed for viability, proliferation, apoptosis, senescence, cytokine secretion, and osteogenic gene expression.
summary_en.result: PEEK supported MSC proliferation and osteogenic differentiation despite lower initial adhesion, with no adverse effects on cell function.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays with tissue culture plate as reference material.

papers.title: On the measurement of dimensional quality of titanium alloy micro lattice struts manufactured using selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The paper describes the measurement of the surface quality, dimensional accuracy, and cross sectional circularity of titanium alloy ( Ti-6Al-4V ) micro struts manufactured using selective laser melting. This quality is related to manufacturing and materials characteristics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于SLM制造钛合金微点阵支柱的尺寸精度和表面质量测量，未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或生物医学植入物背景。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report osseointegration or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 测量SLM钛合金微点阵支柱的尺寸精度和表面质量。
summary_zh.method: 使用光学显微镜和扫描电镜测量支柱的直径、圆度和表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.result: 支柱尺寸偏差与制造参数相关，表面质量受粉末粘附和台阶效应影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量与理论设计值对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the dimensional accuracy and surface quality of Ti-6Al-4V micro lattice struts fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy were used to measure strut diameter, circularity, and surface roughness.
summary_en.result: Dimensional deviations correlated with manufacturing parameters, and surface quality was affected by powder adhesion and stair-step effects.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements were compared with nominal design values.
